fixture: index






Terminal-Fenster local test fixtures



Deterministic pages for exercising the engine, the input transport and the terminal
backends. Everything here opens over file:// with no server and reaches no
network. Read README.md for the conventions; every page also carries its own
contract at window.__bg.expect.





  
fixtureinput
      what it proves





marker convention



Five fixed-position blocks appear on every page so a raw BGRA frame can be located and
sanity-checked without any DOM access:
beacon at (12,12) magenta while loading,
cyan once ready;
status at (36,12) grey/
green/
red;
top-right,
bottom-left,
bottom-right.




hazards



escape-injection.html is hostile by design: it writes terminal control sequences into
document.title the moment it loads. Clear the clipboard first
(pbcopy </dev/null) and use a disposable terminal window. All canaries are
echo-only.



file-upload.html has two buttons that open a real native file chooser. Under
offscreen rendering that panel is invisible and will stall an unattended run. Use
__bg.attachText() instead.



popup.html tries to open windows. The current engine denies them, which is the
expected result, not a failure.
